# scripts/Test-Knowledge.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Checks the organizational second brain's knowledge base (knowledge/): schemas, scope, cross-references and customer data.

Runs every check in docs/knowledge-spec.md §8 and prints one line per finding. Errors fail (exit 1): a file that doesn't match its schema, customer data (LOB apps, engagement trails in the public scope, sensitive text, denylisted customer names), a verdict without evidence, a rule change without history, a closed engagement without a harvest. Warnings (stale catalog entries) don't fail. CI runs it; run it before every harvest PR. The last line is RESULT PASS or RESULT FAIL.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Path` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) 'knowledge')` | The knowledge base to check. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Test-Knowledge.ps1
```
```powershell
./scripts/Test-Knowledge.ps1 -Path ../my-org-brain/knowledge
```
